notes.title: OS OMEGA 1.11 MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
OS OMEGA 1.11 RELEASE NOTES:

- minimap sytem added, showing ground and key items location,
- improved AO baking system for faster and better looking solution,
- redone map system,
- new pad and keyboard mappings,
- AI performance improved,
- new 10 bonus levels,
- new dynamic target lock system with wall detection,
- massive performance improvements,
- over 100 changes in UI/UX,
- over 300 bugs fixed.
